test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following fundamental rights is NOT guaranteed by the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Right to profession**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Right to profession** is not explicitly mentioned as a fundamental right in the Constitution of India.
 
• The Constitution guarantees the right to practice any profession, or to carry on any occupation, trade, or business under Article 19(1)(g), but it is not termed as "Right to profession."
 
• **Right to freedom** includes freedom of speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, and the right to practice any profession.
 
• **Right to equality** guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws.
 
• **Right to freedom of religion** ensures religious freedom and allows individuals to profess, practice, and propagate their religion.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Right to freedom
 Includes various freedoms like speech, assembly, association, movement, residence, and profession.
 
 

 Right to equality
 Guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws.
 
 

 Right to freedom of religion
 Ensures religious freedom, allowing individuals to profess, practice, and propagate their religion.
